result.description:
Salary - 
$150,000 -  $170,000

Purpose – 
This role will lead the presales and solution consulting function for the organisation's enterprise SaaS platforms. Working at the intersection of sales, product and customers, the role is responsible for translating complex business requirements into tailored, value-led software solutions that win and grow strategic enterprise accounts. You will lead a team of solution consultants, and acts as the senior technical and commercial advisor throughout the enterprise sales cycle, with a particular focus on growth across the Asia-Pacific region, including Australia and New Zealand.

Key Responsibilities -
Solution Strategy & Deal Leadership
•	Define and own the presales and solution strategy for assigned enterprise and growth accounts across the product portfolio.
•	Lead customer discovery and requirement-gathering engagements, analysing current-state processes and designing target-state software solutions. 
•	Architect and present complex, multi-product solutions tailored to each customer's operational and commercial context. 
•	Engage senior and executive (CXO-level) stakeholders, articulating solution value through demonstrations, presentations and structured value narratives.
•	Develop return-on-investment and business-impact models that support commercial justification and value-led purchasing decisions. 
•	Support the sales organisation in qualifying, shaping and progressing opportunities through a substantial enterprise pipeline.

Team Leadership & Capability Development
•	Lead, coach and develop a team of senior presales / solution consultants, setting performance standards and supporting career growth.
•	Establish presales best practices, methodologies and quality standards for deliverables across the team.Cross-Functional Collaboration & Market Engagement.
•	Partner with the product organisation to channel structured customer feedback and influence roadmap priorities. 
•	Collaborate with sales, product, delivery and commercial teams to ensure proposed solutions are technically sound, deliverable and commercially viable.
•	Represent the organisation at industry events, forums and customer engagements to support pipeline generation and market visibility.

Selection Criteria – Skills, Qualifications & Experience
•	A bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline; a postgraduate management qualification is highly regarded.
•	Significant experience in enterprise SaaS presales, solution consulting or value engineering, including time in a leadership capacity.
•	Demonstrated success supporting and winning large, complex enterprise deals, ideally across multiple international markets.
•	Strong consultative selling, requirement-analysis, solution-design and commercial value-articulation skills.
•	Proven people-leadership experience, including managing and developing presales or solution-consulting teams.
•	Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, including engagement at executive level.
•	Familiarity with applying modern technologies, including generative AI, to sales and solution workflows.
•	Domain exposure to logistics, supply chain or comparable enterprise software environments is advantageous.

Scope -
The role leads a team of senior presales consultants. It carries accountability for solution outcomes on the organisation's most strategic enterprise opportunities and works closely with regional sales leadership to support revenue growth and market expansion across Asia-Pacific.

Job description:

 
Join a progressive maternity team in North West Tasmania, leading lactation care, education and service innovation.

 

 






 
Living and Working in the Best Place on Earth 

Ready to step away from the pace of the big cities? Imagine starting your day with a walk along the beach, breathing in fresh ocean air before heading into work.

North West Tasmania offers a lifestyle many only dream about-pristine beaches, rugged mountains, world heritage national parks, and welcoming hinterland communities. You'll enjoy fresh local produce, exceptional food and wine, and a relaxed island lifestyle where the pace is kinder and the quality of life is richer.

Experience four distinct seasons, breathtaking natural beauty, and a deep sense of connection to place. Housing is more affordable, commutes are short, and "traffic jam" is rarely part of your vocabulary. This is a place where you can truly achieve work-life balance without compromising your career.

Tasmania | The quiet pursuit of the extraordinary

The Team

The North West Maternity Services (NWMS) is a dynamic, supportive, and agile team working across multiple sites, including the North West Regional Hospital, Mersey Community Hospital, and district hospitals on King Island, Smithton, and the West Coast.

We provide a full spectrum of maternity care-from antenatal services and parenting education through to birth, postnatal care, and extended support into the home as well as a Midwifery Group Practice model of care. Our service includes a 4-bed birthing suite, a 20-bed inpatient ward, and an 8-bed special care nursery.

Our midwives work in a truly collaborative environment alongside allied health professionals, including lactation consultants, social workers, women's health physiotherapists, diabetes educators, and perinatal mental health specialists. We are passionate about delivering contemporary, woman and family-centred care and continuously improving the experiences and outcomes of women and families in our region.

If you're looking to join a team that values innovation, flexibility, and connection-this is your opportunity.

The Role

In this role, you will:

Deliver advanced clinical care and specialist lactation consultancy across Women's and Children's Services in the North West

Support and empower midwifery and nursing teams through education, mentorship, and skill development

Build strong partnerships with women, families, and multidisciplinary teams to enhance care outcomes

Collaborate across Tasmania to improve access to and continuity of lactation services

Lead innovation, quality improvement, and research to strengthen clinical practice and service delivery

From cotton ginning, marketing through to warehousing and exporting, our client is trusted by farmers and customers across Australia to produce and supply superior and consistent quality cotton.

Your Role

As we continue to grow, we are seeking motivated Warehouse Operators (Forklift Drivers) to join our team. In this role, you will play a key part in safely and efficiently handling cotton bales, operating machinery, and preparing shipments.

We are offering this role across several locations:

* Strong communication skills and a positive attitude
* Valid driver’s licence (required)

* Knowledge of safety legislation

About the Role:

The Business Consultant provides expert and timely resource management information, advice and support to ensure that business objectives of the Divisions are met.

The Business Consultant contributes as an equal and integral team member towards service planning and decision making in support of the Divisional Directors, who are responsible for coordinating the business of the Division.

The Business Consultant significantly contributes to the effective and efficient functioning of the service, by providing expert and timely resource management information, advice and support to ensure that business objectives of the Divisions are met.

To be eligible for this position, you must have an appropriate degree in accounting, finance or economics majoring in accounting

About You: 

In this role you will have strong interpersonal and communication skills which will enable you to successfully problem solve, resolve conflicts and negotiate, including the ability to engage in difficult conversations, whilst building and maintaining relationships. An ability to effectively manage multiple, diverse and competing priorities and demonstrated resilience within a stressful and complex environment is essential to this role. 

You will be joining a dynamic and expanding Local Health Network that is committed to delivering contemporary, innovative and high-quality health services within modern facilities. 

This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a passionate, highly driven, dedicated and progressive team. 

About Adelaide: 

Adelaide is consistently recognised as a city that artfully combines its compact charm and world-class cuisine with picturesque nature escapes. Ranked one of the worlds "Most Liveable Cities" and "Most Beautiful Cities", Adelaide provides something for everyone combining a wonderful mix of nature with nearby beaches, rolling hills and wildlife and culinary delights with fine dining restaurants, award-winning cafes, bustling food markets and booming boutique bars. Events like the LIV Golf, SANTOS Tour Down Under, Adelaide Fringe and the Adelaide Cabaret Festival add extra appeal to living here. 

About Us: 

The Northern Adelaide Local Health Network (NALHN) is a leading provider of public healthcare services in South Australia, and one of the largest employers in northern Adelaide. 

NALHN serves over 400,000 people in northern Adelaide with a comprehensive range of high-quality healthcare services, including emergency, surgical, obstetric, neonatal, paediatric, oncology, geriatric, palliative care and rehabilitation, and mental health care, as well as primary health care services with a focus on community health promotion and chronic disease management. 

With a commitment for ongoing upgrades to our facilities and the introduction of new services, our priority is delivering exceptional health and wellbeing services that enhance the quality of life for our community. 

With over 7,000 employees, NALHN emphasises quality care and a supportive work environment guided by respect, integrity, and accountability. Our core values foster excellence, innovation, and equitable health outcomes. 

At NALHN Everyone Has a Story, Everyone Matters, Everyone Contributes and Everyone Grows. 

Our Local Health Network Sites and Services: 

NALHN provides a range of hospital (inpatient), outpatient, community and home-based services across multiple sites in Adelaide's north and north-eastern suburbs, including Aboriginal health, mental health, and GP services. 

Lyell McEwin Hospital - the major hospital in northern Adelaide for emergency care, complex and multi-day surgery, medicine, obstetric, paediatrics and outpatient services. 

Modbury Hospital - a general hospital with emergency care, elective surgery, medicine, outpatient and sub-acute services, rehabilitation, geriatric and palliative care. 

Mental Health Services - adult and older persons mental health services and statewide forensic mental health services, across hospital and community settings. 

Watto Purrunna Aboriginal Primary Health Care Services - provides culturally responsive primary healthcare services for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people in-hospital and across four community sites.
